Apple recently introduced the 600-dollar MacBook Neo. And while a lot is being said about its price and its compromises. I actually think this is the best embodiment of a Mac that we’ve seen in 25 years.

When Steve Jobs introduced the original Macintosh, he said, “It is a product that is not just for the 'techies' or the people that are comfortable with the technology, but for the rest of us... the people that want to use the technology but don't want to have to learn it."

And while that could technically be said for every Mac, I think MacBook Neo best exemplifies that philosophy.
title: Why The MacBook Neo Is Apple's Best Laptop In 25 Years
